description:
The hospital is launching a telemedicine program. As the IT administrator, you need to configure a new visit type in the system so that front-desk staff can properly categorize remote patient encounters.

Create a new visit type through the OpenMRS administration interface with the following details:

- Name: Telehealth Consultation
- Description: Remote patient consultation conducted via video or phone call

To access the OpenMRS administration interface, navigate to: https://localhost/openmrs/admin
Login credentials: username 'superman', password 'Admin123'

Once logged in, find the 'Manage Visit Types' link under the Visits section, then add the new visit type with the exact name and description specified above.

Note: This is the OpenMRS backend administration interface, not the Bahmni clinical frontend. The browser is currently open at the Bahmni home page — you will need to navigate to the OpenMRS admin URL.

metadata.target_description: Remote patient consultation conducted via video or phone call
